HAMILTON COUNTY ADMIN ISTRATI VE FEES 
1. Certificate of Occupancy (CO) where required: 
A. Buildings and structures regulated by the HCBC - $52.46 (- with surcharge and technology fee included)
B. Buildings and structures regulated by the OBBC $170.21 (- with surcharge and technology fee included)
C. Certificate of Completion of Permit (CC) – for all permits where a CO is not required 
Residential - $29.14 (- with surcharge & technology fee included) 
Commercial - $29.14 (- with surcharge & technology fee included) 
2. Certificate of Temporary Occupancy (TCO): 
A. Buildings and structures regulated by the HCBC 
$132.90 – 1 st 30 days + $68.79 each additional 30 days 
If additional TCO is required $ 265.79 – 1 st co days +$ 132.90 each additi on al 30 days 
B. Buildings and structures regulated by the OBC 
$265.79 – 1 st 30 days + $132.90 each additional 30 days 
If additional TCO is required $ 528.0 9 – 1 st 30 days +$ 265.79 each additional 30 days 
C. Occupying w/o TCO, penalty fee 
Residential - $ 265.79 
Com me rc ial - $ 52 8 .09 to be paid in addit ion to TCO fee 
D. Occupying w/o a Certificate of Occupancy 
Residential = $ 265.79 
Commercial=$ 528.09 
3. Refund of Permit Fee (Section HC.A108.4). If granted, shall be in the amount of half the entire permit fee, after deducting the Up-Front Fee and the
Zoning Certificate Fee. 
4. Time Extensions (Section HC.A105.6) each - $100.00 
5. Unspecified Permit Fee – for any permit type, not specifically listed in this Fee Schedule, the fee shall be calculated to the most similar permit type,
use group and type of construction to be determined at the discretion of the Building Official 
6. Scanning fee for Permit Applications reviewed under OBC for paper documents submitted without a digital copy in an approved format: 
• Documents up to 8-1/2 X 14 (including Specs.)…………. $2.40/side 
• Documents larger than 8-1/2 X 11 (B) size…………………$7.01/sheet 
7. Field Inspection and Processing Fee (non-building permit related): 
Residential - $132.90 (- with surcharge & technology fee included) 
Commercial - $170.21 (- with surcharge & technology fee included) 
8. After Hours Inspection (OBC Permits) $162.04 per hour: 
• Minimum fee $648.16 to be paid at time of scheduling inspection + 3% $19.44 + 5% $32.41 = 
9. Plan Review Fee – Accessed at 3 rd review for each hour thereafter: 
Res idential - $132.90 hour (no fractions thereof – rounded up) 
Commercial - $265.79 hour (no fractions thereof – rounded up) 
*Hourly time to include Plan Examiner, Supervisors and Department Head time involved. 
10. Board of Building Appeals: 
Residential $201.68 (- with surcharge and technology fee included) 
Commercial $396.35 (- with surcharge and technology fee included) 
11. Fences over 6’ in height requiring a permit:
Residential - $132.90 (- with surcharge and technology fee included)
Commercial - $170.21 (- with surcharge and technology fee included) 
HAMILTON COUNTY PENALTY FEES 
1. Starting Without a permit – (See Section HC.A105.1.1) – Permit fee + $200% penalty fee 
2. Rescinding a Revoked Permit Fee – (Section HC.A110.6) - $353.26 or original fee whichever is less 
3. Missed Inspection Fee – Failure to schedule a “called-for” inspection before proceeding to cover the work shall result in a Missed Inspection fee: 
Residential - $265.79 (- with surcharge & technology fee included 
Commercial - $265.79 (- with surcharge & technology fee included 
4. Re—inspection fee – Not ready and Failed Inspections shall result in a Re-inspection Fee: 
Residential - $162.04 – (- with surcharge & technology fee included) Commercial –
$162.04 – (- with surcharge & technology fee included) 
5. Violations Penalties (Section HC.A113): 
• Violations issued under the Code shall be punishable by a fine of not more than $300.00 for each offense as provided in Ohio Revised Code
Section 307.37 and 307.99 (C). 
• Violations issued for offenses to ORC Chapters 3781 and 3791 shall not be more than $1,000.00. 
• Each Day that any such violation or failure continues shall be deemed a separate offense.
